test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

CAMERA : MACARE :: BEYOND : YEBDNO :: DEBATE : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b45f452be17f5b54f8c46069c39e0f6c931d4ce8190ab0d96cc01665e3726746.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• **CAMERA : MACARE**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f3815e2bac7eec80a63cb4cc4b14ecc08e811638a32608ef550d9e8b08b6ae7c.png] 

and

 
• **BEYOND : YEBDNO**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/575c7ca951cb0ca58778b08cabac6009b4d8a7afb97f728cbaf7c061a676f886.png] 

Similarly,

 
• **DEBATE** : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c69a70c91ffd1d925decd134debd212535ff6d658e11bd2239b8ff887c3ba89b.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "**BEDETA**".
